description: A 3HP module whose whole function is to paint the rack background a single colour, chosen from its menu

inputs.text: Shifts the red in the background colour while a cable is patched, 10V covering the range from none to full; beyond that the value wraps back round, and a negative voltage folds back up
Shifts the green in the background colour while a cable is patched, 10V covering the range from none to full; beyond that the value wraps back round, and a negative voltage folds back up
Shifts the blue in the background colour while a cable is patched, 10V covering the range from none to full; beyond that the value wraps back round, and a negative voltage folds back up

notes: the three colour jacks are invisible and refuse cables until Toggle CV Inputs is switched on in the module's menu
patching any one of the three colour jacks puts all three under control, the two without a cable holding the colour chosen from the menu
with the lettering hidden the panel is a plain rectangle of the chosen colour and is hard to pick out of the rack; Rack's select tool will find it
bypassing the module leaves the rack's own background showing
colours you save are written to questionablemodules.json in Rack's user folder and are offered in every patch
menu: Change Color — a submenu of twenty-four named colours, any colours you have saved, and Add Custom Color
Add Custom Color — inside Change Color; a name field and red, green and blue sliders that repaint the background as you drag; Save keeps the colour for every patch, Clear returns to Green
Remove Custom Color — inside Change Color; lists the colours you have saved, and clicking one deletes it
Toggle Text — hides the lettering down the panel
Toggle CV Inputs — shows the three colour jacks and lets cables be patched to them
Toggle VCV Shadow — draws Rack's own drop shadow under this module
Toggle Rack — draws the rails and mounting holes over the colour
Box Shadow — a colour list and two sliders, -50 to 50 pixels across and 0 to 50 pixels down, that draw a slab behind every module in the patch
